g.aria-label: Central-Difference Error = Truncation O(h²) + Roundoff O(ε_mach / h)
D₀f(w) = (f(w + h) − f(w − h)) / (2h) ≈ f′(w) + ⅙ f‴(ξ) h² ± ε_mach |f| / h
Balancing h² ~ ε_mach / h gives optimal step h* ∝ ε_mach^{1/3} and min error O(ε_mach^{2/3})
At h ≤ 10⁻⁸: w + h == w → grad = 0!
Always run grad checks in float64!
